anya: FYI hitting a parity issue in sampleapp rerank flow when using Node SDK vs Python. node crashes with length errors
anya: node stack: 
```
TypeError: Cannot read property 'length' of undefined
    at scoreCandidates (/usr/src/app/lib/rerank.js:48:14)
```
devon: can you paste the raw embedding responses from each SDK for the same batched inputs?
anya: python (good):
```
{"id":"c1","embedding":[0.001,-0.21,0.003,...],"model":"open-embed-1536"}
```
anya: node (bad):
```
{"id":"c1","embeds":["0.001,-0.21,0.003,...","0.0009,0.19,..."],"model":"open-embed-1536"}
```
sam: ah, two problems: field name mismatch (`embedding` vs `embeds`) and node returns CSV strings for batched items instead of numeric arrays. rerank expects a numeric array under `embedding`.
anya: note: single-input node calls return `embedding` numeric array. only when input is an array (>1) do we see `embeds` CSVs
devon: sounds like the batching helper is serializing outbound arrays and the response deserializer isn't rehydrating for node. could also be influenced by retry/concat path reported last week.
sam: quick workaround for teams blocked: if resp.embeds then do `const normalized = resp.embeds.map(s => s.split(',').map(Number)).map(e => ({ embedding: e }))` before rerank. i've dropped a snippet in the sampleapp readme.
ops-bot: CI: embed-shape-check.test failed in node-samples (expected number[] but found string CSV).
devon: i'll add a unit/reg test and schedule a patch for node sdk. sam can you investigate batching helper + retry interaction? prioritize sampleapp parity for onboarding docs.
anya: thanks all — pushing the workaround to the onboarding guide and leaving a note on the sampleapp PR #1012 :pray:
